in_sanskrit.name: ईश्वर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who owns, rules and controls the universe.

in_hindi.name: ईश्वर
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is the master, lord or controller. The one who is the giver of boons or blessings.

in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is the controller, ruler or possessor. The one who is the giver of boons or blessings.

in_marathi.name: Eashwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Creation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eashwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eashwar is a name derived from Sanskrit language. It is a form of Lord Shiva, the supreme deity in Hinduism, representing creation, destruction, and regeneration. Eashwar is the preserver of the universe and is believed to be the god of fertility, prosperity, and auspiciousness.
